title: Akbar e mehroo ko dulha to bana lijiye hussain
body:
AKBAR-E-MAHROO KO DULHA TO BANALIJIYE HUSSAIN
GHAM ZADA ZAINAB KA ARAMAAN TO NIKALIJIYE HUSSAIN
HAM SHABIHE MUSTAFA KO DEKHLIJIYE GHOUR SE
WAQTE RUQSATH HAI KALEJEY SE LAGALIJIYE HUSSANI
<<DIVIDER>>
DIL SAMBHALE AMBIYA HEIN DEKHNE KEY WASTE
SEENAYE AKBER SE BARCHI KO NIKALIJIYE HUSSAIN
HAI ZAAIFI MEIN UTHANA NOUJAWAN KI LAASH KO
APNE BABA KO SADA DEKAR BULALIJIYE HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KISTARAH DEKHEGI MADAR LAASHAYE KARDIYAL JAWAN
MARNA JAYE GHAM SE LAILA KO SAMBHALIJIYE HUSSAIN
UTHNA PAYEGA JAWAN BETE KA LAASHA AAP SE
AB ZARA QAIME SE BACCHAO KO BULALIJIYE HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ILTEJA MAZHAR KI HAI YEH APSE SIBTE NABI
APNE ROUZE PAR ISE JALDI BULALIJIYE HUSSAIN
